text: Withdrew the guarantee that a contradicted claim remains samplable and may be labelled immaterial. Both halves were false: PAWL-007 AC1 selects cleared changesets and AC4 here makes a contradicted changeset fail, so it never enters the sampled population; and immaterial is from the four-value proposal PAWL-007 explicitly rejected for conflating its axes. Whether contradictions should be sampled is a real question and belongs to PAWL-007
